note: Ceiling for the published image (#2132). Compressed bytes - what crosses the wire on a pull. MEASURED IN CI (ubuntu-latest, docker-build-smoke.yml), because that is the environment that gates. NEVER lower this to match a laptop - and the reason is now PROVEN, not assumed (#2134): the number depends on the DAEMON'S IMAGE STORE. The same published artifact (ghcr.io/astrapi69/adaptive-learner:2.8.2, amd64) measured 125606171 bytes on a runner (classic graphdriver, overlay2) and 112828486 bytes on a containerd-image-store machine - 12.78 MB apart, same command, same bytes of content. docker save emits already-compressed blobs under the containerd store and raw layer tars under the classic graphdriver, and gzip -1 packs the latter far worse. Base-image and apt drift were the ORIGINAL guess here and are ruled out: the local base image was digest-identical to the current one (docker pull -> 0 byte delta).
_tightening: Tightening stays MANUAL (#2140): the gate offers headroom above the jitter tolerance but never applies it. This ceiling is a CI measurement; a local run lowering it would pin the project to one machine's IMAGE STORE, which is worth ~12.8 MB (#2134, proven by measuring the same published image on both stores - run 30638091353).
_raise_2575: Raised 125668464 -> 126148228 (#2575, docker-build-smoke.yml run 31693708819): eruda, the ?debug=1-gated on-device debugging console, ships in frontend `dependencies` because it must be fetchable on the deployed build, not just local dev - its chunk is excluded from the PWA precache (globIgnores) but still ships as a static asset in the image's frontend/dist. Deliberate --allow-raise, CI-measured, not a local reading.
_per_arch_note: Per-architecture ceilings (#2147) - two published architectures are two environments (#2136 point 5), so neither may borrow the other's number. amd64 carries the CI measurement from docker-build-smoke.yml. arm64 was seeded from image-size-measure.yml run 30532123506 (native ubuntu-24.04-arm, gzip -1, after the #2163 runs-on fix; the workflow reports and a human enters, per #2140).
_measurement_paths: Seeding measures a locally built+loaded image; enforcement measures one pulled from a registry. Verified 2026-07-29 that both paths mean the same number: the same image measured locally and after a push/pull round-trip through a throwaway registry:2 differed by 14 bytes of 112325662 (0.000%) - three orders of magnitude inside the 2 MB rebuild-jitter tolerance. So a ceiling seeded from a measurement run is valid against the published artifact. Re-verify if the packaging changes (a different registry, a different image store, or zstd-compressed layers).
_tolerance_note: Tolerance is +/-200000 bytes around each ceiling: ~4.2x the measured rebuild jitter (47651 bytes between identical-content builds). Above ceiling+tolerance fails (growth); below ceiling-tolerance fails too (an unexpected shrink is a finding, #2135 both directions). Ceilings re-anchored to the v2.8.0 PUBLISHED per-arch measurements (run 30548288561) so the next growth is measured from what users actually pull.
